decisions.reason: Grounds the diagnosis in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk 200s but sibling imports resolve relative to the fetched chunk URL, the siblings were never shipped, so import() rejects despite HTTP 200; proposes a self-contained single-file bundle with code splitting disabled (inlineDynamicImports / no manualChunks) and notes the full-asset alternative.

Cites chunk-route.ts and the ci-note.md debug print: case-sensitive startsWith compares LIB_DIR's uppercase E:\ (from fileURLToPath/import.meta.url) against realpathSync's OS-reported lowercase e:\, rejecting a contained file; explains Linux passes because no component casing is rewritten and the laptop passed by coincidence. Explicitly rejects the maintainer's 'Windows paths are unreliable' folklore rather than endorsing it.

Proposes canonicalizing both sides via realpathSync (root once, file per request) then path.relative-based containment rejecting empty/'..'/absolute results; realpath resolution also covers symlink escapes and symlinked LIB_DIR, and win32-lowercasing is applied only to both canonicalized sides. Explicitly preserves the application/javascript MIME type required by dynamic import. Grounded in the fixture route source; no executed test needed.

Explains both wheel handlers act on the same bubbling Ctrl+wheel with no arbitration, gives the modal exclusive ownership while open (preventDefault + stopPropagation/stopImmediate, capture on overlay root), and has the pane stand down via composedPath/overlay-open checks, restoring ownership on close.

Planned checks with expected outcomes for all three incidents: build-artifact gate asserting the emitted chunk has no unshipped sibling specifiers (or every referenced file ships under the route); guard tests with a case-differing drive-letter fixture expecting 200 while traversal/encoded/absolute/symlink escapes expect 403/404; DOM wheel test asserting modal zoom with preventDefault, pane font handler not invoked while modal is open, and pane handler firing again after close.

caps.reason: The proposed fix strengthens containment (dual realpath canonicalization plus relative-based traversal/escape rejection); serving outside the resource root appears only as rejected traversal test cases, not as advice.
